high_level_description: stc brand style, a family scene in a modern living room with a boy seated on a velvet sofa.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A contemporary living room with dark teal walls, white trim molding, a dark purple velvet sofa, a glass-top coffee table with ornate metalwork, a zebra print area rug, a dark wooden staircase, and warm recessed and sconce lighting.

elements.desc: A young boy wearing a light-colored shirt, seated on the sofa.
A person wearing a light pink hijab and casual attire, standing in the background near the kitchen area.
A large abstract painting with red, blue, and white streaks hanging on the wall.
